sloka: अपृच्छत तदा रामो दक्षिणाशाश्रमं मुनिम् ।प्राञ्जलिर्विनयोपेत इदमाह वचो ऽर्थवत् ।। ७.३५.१ ॥
transliteration: apṛcchata tadā rāmo dakṣiṇāśāśramaṁ munim ।prāñjalirvinayopeta idamāha vaco 'rthavat ।। 7.35.1 ॥

translations.english: Then Rama, with folded hands and full of humility, asked the sage (Agastya) in the hermitage of the southern direction, speaking these meaningful words.
